test_cases.name: Verbose initial quote request from primary contact
test_cases.description: A verbose customer email from Fresh HelloFoods requesting a quote for several catalog items, establishing detailed business context and requirements. The initial turn sets up the quote request from the primary contact email, enabling a later follow-up approval from an alternate contact to trigger intervention for cross-contact identity resolution.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Multiple Items for Upcoming Promotion
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out on behalf of Fresh HelloFoods as we are preparing for our upcoming promotional campaign and would like to request a detailed quote for several items listed in your catalog. Our team is currently evaluating options for both food and non-food products to feature in our stores, and we want to ensure we have accurate pricing and availability before finalizing our selections.

Specifically, please provide a quote for the following:

- Pizza (we noticed there are several variants in your catalog; please include pricing for each available Pizza option so we can compare)
- Mango (Item No: AITEM-0072) – quantity: 50 units
- Rasta Coffee Grinder (Item No: AITEM-0027) – quantity: 2 units
- Soda - Medium (Item No: AITEM-0061) – quantity: 20 units

If there are any minimum order requirements or lead times for these products, please include those details in your response. Also, if you offer any bundled pricing or volume discounts, kindly highlight those as well.

We look forward to receiving your quote so we can proceed with our internal review and next steps.

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods

test_cases.name: Initial Quote Request with Detailed Context for Cross-Contact Approval Scenario
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer initiates a quote request for several catalog items, providing detailed background and context, but does not mention any future approval or alternate contact. The email sets up the scenario for a later follow-up approval from a different email address, which will require the system to resolve cross-contact identity and quote linkage.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote: Toys, Apparel, and Beverages
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. My name is Danish Pastry, and I am reaching out on behalf of our team at Danish Pastry. We are currently planning a small event for our staff and their families, and as part of our preparations, we are looking to source a variety of items suitable for both children and adults. I would appreciate it if you could provide a detailed quote for the following products from your catalog:

- 2 sets of SmartToys Building Blocks (these are always a hit at our gatherings, and we would like to ensure we have enough for group activities)
- 3 T-Shirts (we noticed you have several T-Shirt options listed, so please include the available styles and sizes in your quote)
- 12 bottles of Soda - Large (for the refreshment table)

If you require any additional information to prepare the quote, please let me know. We are aiming to finalize our selections soon, so a prompt response would be greatly appreciated. Thank you very much for your assistance and attention to detail.

Best regards,
Danish Pastry

test_cases.name: Initial Quote Request with Detailed Context
test_cases.description: A verbose and informal initial quote request from Tom Martinez (Home), providing extra context and requesting a quote for several catalog items. The email establishes the business context and sets up for a follow-up approval from a different contact.

initial_turn.subject: Looking for a Quote on a Few Items
initial_turn.body:
Hey there,

Hope you’re having a good day! I’m reaching out because I’d like to get a quote for a few things I’m planning to order soon. Just to give you a bit of background, I’m putting together a small event for my family and some friends, so I’m looking for a mix of snacks, drinks, and maybe a couple of fun items for the kids. I figured it’d be easiest to get everything from you guys in one go if possible.

Here’s what I’m thinking:
- 2 x Pizza (I see a few options in your catalog, so just include the ones you have available and let me know what the differences are)
- 3 x Soda - Medium
- 1 x WonderWagon Electric Train (my nephew is obsessed with trains, so this would be perfect for him)
- 1 x Playlandia Colorful Play Mat (for the younger kids to play on)

If you could send me a quote with pricing and any info on delivery times, that would be awesome. If you need any more details from me, just let me know. I’ll probably have someone else from my household follow up if I’m not available, but I’ll make sure they reference this request.

Best regards,
Tom Martinez (Home)
